subject: Reminders of Him
query: is reminders of him based on a book
title: Is Reminders of Him based on a book? Yes, Colleen Hoover's 2022 novel
answer: Yes. Reminders of Him is based on Colleen Hoover's novel of the same name, published on Jan. 18, 2022. The Universal Pictures film opened in theaters on March 13, 2026, streamed on Peacock from July 10, 2026, and arrives on Netflix in the U.S. on Tuesday, Nov. 10, 2026.
body:
The book follows Kenna, who learns she is pregnant only after she is imprisoned for the death of her boyfriend, Scotty. Her daughter, Diem, is born while she is in prison, and Scotty's parents get custody. After her release Kenna wants to know her daughter, who is now 5, but Scotty's parents refuse to hear her side and have a restraining order against her. Ledger, Scotty's best friend, helps raise Diem and blames Kenna, yet finds himself drawn to her.

The movie was directed by Vanessa Caswill (Love at First Sight) from a screenplay by Colleen Hoover and Lauren Levine. Maika Monroe plays Kenna Rowan and Tyriq Withers plays Ledger Ward; Rudy Pankow, Lauren Graham, Bradley Whitford and country singer Lainey Wilson also appear.

The film comes to Netflix through Universal's deal that sends its live-action movies to Netflix after their first streaming window. The Nov. 10 date applies to the U.S.; the film was already on Netflix in some countries, including Australia and New Zealand. What's on Netflix expects it to leave Netflix around September 2027 and return to Peacock.
in_the_news: The Colleen Hoover adaptation Reminders of Him starts streaming on Netflix in the U.S. on Nov. 10, 2026.

faq.q: Who wrote the book Reminders of Him?
faq.a: Colleen Hoover. The novel was published on Jan. 18, 2022, by Montlake Romance.

faq.q: When is Reminders of Him on Netflix?
faq.a: Tuesday, Nov. 10, 2026, in the U.S. It was on Peacock first, from July 10, 2026.

faq.q: Who plays Kenna and Ledger in Reminders of Him?
faq.a: Maika Monroe plays Kenna Rowan and Tyriq Withers plays Ledger Ward.

faq.q: Is Reminders of Him a true story?
faq.a: No. It is a novel by Colleen Hoover, not a real case.
